Definition: Jerachmeel, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jerahmeel is the name of three Israelites, a son of Hezron among them. In 1 Chronicles 2:9, Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai. The fuller story is told on the Jerahmeel profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jerahmeel matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
